risk_note: RV1 by path (apps/h5; no money logic). H5 help centre: /help lists help-category articles in server order with load-more (in-flight dedupe), /help?article_id= shows one article through the shared ArticleBody (mediaOrigins()), 30701 shows the offline empty state even over cached data, support opens through bridge cs.open with a fixed entry and is hidden when unavailable; the client comes from useApi(). The six category cards and the category list of the board are not built (the contract has no help sub-category; contract slot requested). Rule tests by Codex in one call (29 tests; router pieces re-exported from pages/help/router.ts because the test workspace has no react-router), Claude spec-test review 1 round pass, red on the test machine (red/1). Implementation by Opus 5.5 in two rounds (round 2: the Codex review S1 on a stale body after 30701). Test machine verify-fast/3 and browser/2 green; help route chunk about 3 KB gzip. Review: Codex (approvals id 27 / 34). Written by hand.

reviews.note: round 1 fail (S1: an expired cached article stayed on screen when the refetch returned 30701), implementation round 2 fixed it with unit tests; round 2 pass, no findings

spec_test_review.note: fresh Claude subagent: pass with one S2 (double tap on load-more not tested), carried into the implementation brief and implemented
